AGES 6–8

Curious makers

A little more independence. Choose an activity together and adapt it to your learner.

Science Lab
Ages 6–1220 min + daily check-ins

Grow a bean ↗

Watch roots and shoots appear, then draw the changes in your own bean diary.

Art Studio
Ages 3–825 min

Make a shape collage ↗

Tear, arrange and layer colourful paper to make a picture that is entirely your own.

Maths Room
Ages 3–815 min

Make a repeating pattern ↗

Turn big paper shapes into repeating patterns and challenge someone to find your rule.

Story Corner
Ages 6–1230 min

Draw a story map ↗

Invent a character, give them a problem and draw their way to an ending.

Nature Club
Ages 3–1215 min

Make a sound map ↗

Listen from one safe spot and draw a map of the sounds around you.

Build & Tinker
Ages 6–1230 min

Build a paper bridge ↗

Test how folding changes a paper bridge, then improve your design with a fair comparison.
